scripts.build: npm run build:app && npm run build:site && npm run assemble:site
scripts.check:site: cross-env ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro sync && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.site.json
scripts.verify:web: npm run check:site && npm run build && npm test
scripts.verify:server: npm --prefix server run check && npm --prefix server run build
scripts.verify:desktop: npm run build:app && cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.verify: npm run verify:web && npm run verify:server && npm run verify:desktop
